games.name: Producer Race
games.short: Pick the producer that wins each race.
games.line: Pick the producer that wins each 6-hour race, four a day (Sunday's races are for fun: All time only). A 2nd or 3rd place finish scores a Show.
games.lineTypes: Pick the producer that wins each race: 1-hour, 2-hour, 6-hour, daily or weekly (Sunday's races are for fun: All time only). 1st, 2nd and 3rd score points.

board.unranked: To play on the Staked board, stake at least 1 VHP in the Producer Race.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (from Week 4, the week of Mon 16 Nov).

games.name: Daily Questions
games.short: Answer quick questions about block producers.
games.line: Answer quick questions about block producers, Monday to Saturday. Stake VHP to share the weekly rewards.

games.name: Who Signs Block X
games.short: Pick who signs the next milestone block.
games.line: Pick the producer that signs each milestone block, about one an hour.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in Block X that week.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (picks on 3 or more days, at least 1 point).

games.name: Survivor
games.short: One producer a day. Two lives. Outlast everyone.
games.line: One producer a day, two lives, each producer once a season. Two-week seasons; Season 1 is practice from Mon 30 Nov, paid from Season 2 (Mon 14 Dec).

games.name: Fantasy Producers
games.short: Draft five producers and name a captain.
games.line: Draft 5 producers under a salary cap, with a captain who scores double. Weeks 4 and 5 are free play. Stake now: it counts from week 6 (Sun 29 Nov, 7 PM ET).

games.name: Block Golf
games.short: Your places in every game set your score.
games.line: Every Knode Games game is a hole: your place on each game's weekly board sets your strokes. Nothing to pick; lowest score wins.

board.unranked: Block Golf is free to play: everyone is on one board.

games.name: Producer Bracket
games.short: Pick every winner in a weekly knockout.
games.line: A weekly knockout of block producers, head to head: one round a day, the final on Saturday. Pick every winner by Monday night. Week 4 (Mon 16 Nov) is practice; staked rewards start Week 5.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in the Producer Bracket that week.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (from Week 5, the week of Mon 23 Nov; at least 1 point).

games.name: Last Node Standing
games.short: One node is knocked out each hour. Pick a survivor.
games.line: Pick a node. Every hour the unluckiest node is knocked out; jump once if yours goes. Ride the last node standing.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in Last Node Standing that week.

free.prize: The Free play board pays no VHP prize for now. Players staked in Last Node Standing share its weekly bucket.

games.name: Knode Games VS
games.short: Pick which producers beat our node.
games.line: Pick which producers beat our node. One call a day.

board.soon: Producer lists from Mon 30 Nov (picks open Fri 27, 7 PM ET).

free.prize: Knode Games VS is free play and pays no prizes yet.

games.name: More or Fewer
games.short: Will a producer sign more or fewer blocks?
games.line: Call whether a producer signs more or fewer blocks than the number shown. A new game every 30 minutes; one point for each right call.

free.prize: More or Fewer is free play and pays no prizes yet.

games.name: Combo Card
games.short: Stack 2 to 10 calls on one card.
games.line: Build a card of 2 to 10 calls from the races and Block X. Every leg must hit; harder legs pay more. Preview: build and share cards now; practice play from Wed 25 Nov, staking from Sun 6 Dec, 7 PM ET.
